Corgi 0.1.0

The first release. Corgi tiles your windows side by side, snaps them to halves, thirds and quarters, and keeps them on ten virtual workspaces.

  • Tiling: new windows take a share of the screen. Focus and move tiles with the keyboard, flip a split, float a window, or show one window at a time with the full-screen layout.
  • Snapping: keyboard shortcuts for halves, thirds, quarters and your own custom sizes, or drag a window to an edge or corner. Prefer to arrange things yourself? Switch automatic tiling off and just snap.
  • Workspaces: switch with ⌥1–⌥0 and send windows with ⌥⇧. Name them, send apps to the same one every time, and move a whole workspace to another display.
  • Mouse: optional focus follows mouse, and mouse follows focus.
  • Scripting: run any command from a corgi:// link.
  • Menu bar: the corgi shows which workspace you're on; its menu lists each workspace with its apps.

Press ⌃⌥/ any time to see every shortcut.

Privacy: Corgi needs Accessibility access to move and resize windows. It collects nothing, and only goes online to check for updates.
